betting_audit_2026_11_13.question: Can even-money bets on every race from R3 onward (grind, ladder, finale) buy a big mid-campaign T3 pile or break the 1.07 cap?
betting_audit_2026_11_13.sim: unapproved/barry/econ-v1/run_betting.py and betting_results.json; RESULTS.md Betting section
betting_audit_2026_11_13.finding: L30 floor and 1.07 cap bind. Betting does not put the player on the R3 boss or finale bosses at a higher cap, or noticeably earlier in races, than the no-bet walk. The real exploit is even-money max bets on high-WR grind races (especially the 31–106 finale XP grinds), which prints on the order of $150k–$240k for favorites. The existing bet_max_finale_gain=$8,000 note assumed bets on the four billed finale races only.
betting_audit_2026_11_13.recommended_fix_detail: Allow bets only on ladder/story and billed finale races, not on grind/wild races. Keep BET_MIN $500, BET_MAX $2,000, even odds. This restores the $8,000 four-race finale cap. Alternative if grind betting should stay as flavor: post odds that depend on r (fair (1-p)/p), which zeros expected profit on the farm.
not_recommended_as_sufficient_alone: cap bet at the purse ($742.50 on R3 wilds still prints; crew/boss purses still allow a $2,000 even-money bet)
BET_MAX $500 (still ~+$60k over the finale grind for 80/80)
3 bets per round (kills early T3 farm only partially; finale still has many rounds/steps)
betting_audit_2026_11_13.T3_best_legal_note: 5 regular T3 upgrades at $4,000 plus one T3 aero at 1.75× = $7,000. Full T1+T2+T3 path is $53,400.

PASS otherwise. Shop leftover near $0 is not ruin. Mixed 'worth it' if mean 60/80+80/60 profit >= one R3 crew purse ($3,375).
betting_levers_factorial_2026_11_13.headline: Uncapped even-money bets on grind/wild races print ~$150k–$250k at either unlock; T4 price does not soak that printer. A bet-count cap of 4 or 8, story-only eligibility, or true fair odds all pass criterion 6. Austin picks the combination.
